title: Northbeam TechWorks Labour Tariff and Chargeable Time Basis
content:
Schedule L of the Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair tariff sets, for each of the six TechWorks services, the standard chargeable labour rate in USD per hour, the least labour billed on a job in hours, the basis on which labour time is rounded when it is billed, and the number of items that may be worked on in one visit.

## L.1 The four figures of this schedule

1. **Standard chargeable labour rate** — the rate, in USD for each hour, at which chargeable labour is billed under that service.
2. **Least labour billed on a job** — the smallest quantity of labour, in hours, that a job carries.
3. **Rounding of labour time** — how labour time is rounded when it is billed.
4. **Items in one visit** — the number of items that may be worked on in a single attendance.

## L.2 Schedule of figures

| TechWorks service | Rate, USD per hour | Least labour billed, hours | Labour time rounded | Items in one visit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 89.00 | 0.5 | up to the next quarter hour | 3 |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 119.00 | 1.0 | up to the next quarter hour | 2 |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 159.00 | 2.0 | up to the next half hour | 4 |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 129.00 | 1.5 | up to the next half hour | 2 |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 175.00 | 2.0 | up to the next quarter hour | 25 |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 145.00 | 1.0 | up to the next quarter hour | 40 |

## L.3 Footnotes to the schedule

- The rate of a bench job at the store counter, 89.00 USD an hour, is the lowest of the six; the rate of a business deployment, 175.00 USD an hour, is the highest. The annual care service is rated at 145.00 USD an hour, below the deployment service it otherwise resembles.
- The least labour billed runs from half an hour at the counter to two hours on a calibration and on a business deployment, with one hour on a standard home installation and on the annual care service and one and a half hours on an appliance installation.
- Two of the six services round labour time up to the next half hour — the calibration service and the appliance service — and the remaining four round up to the next quarter hour.
- The item count of one visit is three at the counter, two on a standard home installation and on an appliance installation, four on a calibration, twenty-five on a business deployment and forty on the annual care service.
